texts: When a sky-cat descends, the sky-cat hunts nightmoths.
When a sky-cat hunts nightmoths at a lantern-row, the nightmoth crowd at that lantern-row shrinks.
Whenever a sky-cat hunts nightmoths at a lantern-row, the nightmoth crowd at that lantern-row thins.
After a sky-cat hunts at a lantern-row, the thread harvest at that lantern-row falls.

fields.sentence: When a sky-cat descends, the sky-cat hunts nightmoths.

q1_issues.issue: The object of "hunts" is given Patient, but hunting neither creates, destroys, consumes nor physically changes the nightmoths, so the stated object test - and its "when unclear, default to Theme" fallback - points to Theme.

review.notes: Routing of bare "when P, Q" with an indefinite trigger participant onto the whenever machinery, the genus atoms for sky_cat and the solid-spelled nightmoth, the Skolem-function consequent with its During link at (STV 1.0 0.9), and the absence of a QuantifierPhrase companion all follow the instruction set.

issues.reason: Licensed by precedent: the instruction set's own forall-forall example gives the quarry of the pursuit verb chase (`every dog chased every cat`) the `Patient` role, and `hunt` is the same pursue-a-quarry frame, so `Patient` here follows a stated example rather than violating the object test.

new_gaps: object role of a pursuit verb (hunt / chase / pursue): the 'does the object itself change?' test with its Theme default points to `Theme`, while the forall-forall example emits `chase` -> `Patient`; the instruction set needs one legislated line so statements and questions match
adjudication.notes: Everything else follows the instruction set: bare 'when P, Q' with an indefinite trigger routed to the whenever machinery, the Skolem event a function of both the sky-cat and the descend occurrence, the bare-plural generic object as a bare kind filler, and the two compound genus atoms.

fields.sentence: When a sky-cat hunts nightmoths at a lantern-row, the nightmoth crowd at that lantern-row shrinks.
parse: (: hunt_shrink_rule (Implication (And (Member $h hunt) (Agent $h $c) (Member $c sky_cat) (Theme $h night_moth) (Location $h $r) (Member $r lantern_row)) (And (Member (sk_shrink $h) shrink) (Patient (sk_shrink $h) (sk_crowd $r)) (Member (sk_crowd $r) crowd) (GroupOf (sk_crowd $r) night_moth) (LocatedIn (sk_crowd $r) $r) (During (sk_shrink $h) $h))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: a presupposed definite NP in a generic rule's consequent whose restrictor is a premise variable ('the nightmoth crowd at that lantern-row'): the instruction set bars Skolem terms from premises but gives no route for keeping such a referent's existence and typing outside the rule, so the crowd's Member / GroupOf / LocatedIn atoms exist only when the rule fires
review.notes: Roles, heads and TVs all check out: Theme for the hunted moths, Patient for the shrinking undergoer, entity-attached LocatedIn (not Location) for 'at that lantern-row', and crowd = Member + GroupOf per the flock-of-birds pattern, with genus-only decomposition for sky_cat / lantern_row / night_moth. One firing caveat: the premise pins the hunt's Theme to the bare kind symbol `night_moth`, so the rule cannot match a hunt event whose object was stored as a group witness.

fields.sentence: Whenever a sky-cat hunts nightmoths at a lantern-row, the nightmoth crowd at that lantern-row thins.
parse: (: whenever_hunt_thin (Implication (And (Member $e1 hunt) (Agent $e1 $x) (Member $x sky_cat) (Patient $e1 nightmoth) (Location $e1 $r) (Member $r lantern_row)) (And (Member (sk_thin $e1) thin) (Patient (sk_thin $e1) (sk_crowd $r)) (Member (sk_crowd $r) crowd) (GroupOf (sk_crowd $r) nightmoth) (LocatedIn (sk_crowd $r) $r) (During (sk_thin $e1) $e1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: The indefinite 'a lantern-row' is correctly a premise variable so 'that lantern-row' can bind to it donkey-style, and the crowd is a Skolem function of that variable; 'at' is in the containment list so LocatedIn on the crowd entity is the right head.

fields.sentence: After a sky-cat hunts at a lantern-row, the thread harvest at that lantern-row falls.
parse: (: after_hunt_harvest_falls (Implication (And (Member $e hunt) (Agent $e $s) (Member $s sky_cat) (Location $e $r) (Member $r lantern_row)) (And (Member (sk_harvest $e) thread_harvest) (LocatedIn (sk_harvest $e) $r) (Member (sk_fall $e) fall) (Theme (sk_fall $e) (sk_harvest $e)) (Before $e (sk_fall $e)))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: generic "After P, Q" with indefinite participants: the occurrence-quantifying rule route is stated only for "every time / whenever" and bare "when", and the whenever machinery hard-wires a `During` link from response to trigger, so nothing says how an "after" conditional routes or where its `Before` ordering goes inside the rule's conclusion
review.notes: The definite "thread harvest" is minted as the dependent-existential Skolem `(sk_harvest $e)` — the licensed forall-exists shape — but it indexes the row's harvest on the hunting occasion rather than on the row, so two hunts at one row yield two harvest entities. Compound genera, the at-locative split (event `Location` vs entity `LocatedIn`), the scalar-change `Theme` on `fall`, and the after-to-`Before` swap are all correct.
